about: The xAI Imagine request values this repo accepts. One file, read by scripts/xai_api.py (the CLIs) and scripts/content-index/generation.ts (the generationDefaults schema), so the two can never disagree. Source: docs.x.ai, POST /v1/images/generations and POST /v1/videos/generations. The server stays the authority on model ids, so models are not enumerated here.
